title: An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization: Supporting Data and Code
description: Proposed v0.3.0 software and data archive accompanying the manuscript and Supplementary Information by Gagan Sai Amith Pennada, VIT-AP University, India. GitHub source repository: https://github.com/amith2427/Green-Catalyst-Screening. Existing Zenodo project record (concept DOI): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23383768. The proposed upload ZIP contains the final main manuscript PDF, final Supplementary Information PDF, the 5,000-row Seed 42 synthetic dataset, the 20-seed metrics and TreeSHAP log for seeds 42–61, the supplementary positive-control and learning-curve log, citation references, checksums, and draft metadata. All reaction data and targets are synthetic. This metadata is a draft for a new version of the existing Zenodo record; no v0.3.0 version has been deposited or published, and no new version DOI has been assigned.
references: Pennada, Gagan Sai Amith. An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization. Manuscript. VIT-AP University, India.

Pennada, Gagan Sai Amith. Supplementary Information for An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization. VIT-AP University, India.
